thread:
emma (product): FYI — rolling out SDK v3.0 beta + docs overhaul today. Main callouts: new auth header (X-Redwood-API-Key v2), streaming default changed to chunked=true, and a consolidated "migration-guide.md" in the docs site. Full notes + quick migration snippet below. Please read if you own any SDK integrations.

riley (devex): thanks emma. timeline? is this opt-in or force?

emma (product): opt-in for 2 weeks, then we'll flip default for new installs, and 6 weeks after that we'll start deprecating the old header with 30-day rotation warnings. See deprecation timeline in doc link.

mike (eng): quick tech question — are we changing the default retry/backoff behavior too? some customers rely on old jitter settings.

emma (product): good point. retry/jitter stays the same by default, but v3 exposes a new Config.retryProfile that teams can opt into. We'll call it out in the changelog.

sasha (docs): I've pushed the new migration-guide.md and examples. Migration snippet (Node):
```js
// v2 -> v3 migration: switch header and enable chunked streaming optionally
const client = new RedwoodSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY_V2, // still works during opt-in window
  authHeader: 'X-Redwood-API-Key-v2',
  streaming: { chunked: true }
});
```

julia (pm): can we get a short checklist for customer success and PS so they know what to say on calls?

riley (devex): I'll draft a 1-pager and a short script for CS. Will ping @sasha for docs snippets.

mike (eng): any automated compatibility tests? i can add a CI job that runs sample workloads against v2/v3 clients.

emma (product): excellent — add tests and flag any perf regressions. If you find slower latencies, notify eng-runtime right away.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-site/migration-guide -> staging (build 5938). ETA ~5m.

sasha (docs): staging up, link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/migration-guide

julia (pm): for the deprecation windows, let's also send an email to active customers and add an in-console banner. Ops/marketing, can we coordinate?

riley (devex): will coordinate with growth for the banner and with support for the email template.

mike (eng): one more: telemetry keys change slightly for v3. We've added an opt-in telemetry.version field. Make sure privacy/compliance signoff.

emma (product): noted — security team to review, @riley will loop them in.

riley (devex): tagging: @security-team can you review telemetry.version opt-in?

sasha (docs): updated migration-guide with a 'quick revert' snippet and common pitfalls.

emma (product): wrap-up: opt-in starts now, default flip for new installs in 2 weeks, deprecation warnings start in 8 weeks, full retire in 14 weeks. Please escalate any blockers here. :rocket:
